verdict.rationale: Price changes for existing subscribers are a fair question for a subscription billing platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack only describes the general product catalog: item prices, multi-frequency billing and AI-drafted plans. Nothing in it documents plan versioning, grandfathering existing subscribers, or bulk migration of cohorts to new prices.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can change pricing without breaking existing subscribers — versioned plans, grandfathering, and bulk migration tools for moving cohorts to new prices
